question: How should I structure SDR commission to discourage gaming MQL counts?
answer:
**Pay SDRs on accepted SQLs (AQLs), not MQL output; gate commission on a 30-day bounce-back hold + AE validation.** This flips incentive from lead-count gaming to lead-quality gatekeeping. MQL definitions collapse under commission pressure—you'll see 80% of SDR volume evaporate, then volume regrows as true qualified activity. **Why MQL Counts Collapse Under Commission:** 1. **Quality asymmetry:** An SDR can hit 50 MQLs/month with phone verification alone. A validated SQL takes 3–5 discovery calls, discovery notes, buying signal documentation. MQL comp incentivizes the path of least resistance. 2. **Churn rate myth:** Companies paying on MQL watch 35–45% fail to become AQL within 30 days. True booking rate (MQL → demo → qualified opportunity) is 12–18%, not 40%. 3. **Sales team toxicity:** AEs get 200 weekly MQL dumps they never touch. They stop trusting SDR routing, hire assistant AEs instead, or build shadow SDR teams. Pavilion data: teams with MQL-based SDR comp have 60% higher AE churn. **Correct Structure:** **Metric:** SDR paid on **AQL (Accepted Qualified Lead)** defined as: - Lead routed to AE + documented discovery outcome (budget, timeline, champion ID, pain + product fit) - AE hits "Accept" in CRM within 48 hours of routing (creates contractual obligation) - No payment if AE rejects within 30 days (SDR keeps 50% of commission if AE closed it after 30 days; incentivizes follow-through) **Comp Model:** | Activity | Payment | |----------|--------| | AQL Accepted | $20–$50 per AQL (depends on territory TAM) | | AQL → Booked Demo | $10 bonus | | AQL → Closed Won | $100–$250 bonus | | MQL-to-AQL Conversion < 20% | Comp reduced 10% that month (reverse negative selection) | **Quota Formula:** - 40 AQLs/month × $35/AQL = $1,400 base commission (at 100%) - Bonus pool: additional $4,200 if team conversion (AQL → booked demo) hits 50%+ - Ramp: 50% of quota months 1–3; 75% months 4–6; 100% month 7+ **The Clawback Mechanism:** If AQL bounces (AE marks "Not Qualified" within 30 days), SDR loses 100% of bonus on that AQL but keeps 50% of base ($17.50) if AE later converts. This prevents SDR gaming while rewarding the ones who accidentally found something valuable. **Metrics to Track:** 1. **AQL-to-AQM (Accepted Qualified Meeting):** Target 40–55%. Below 25% = SDRs routing tier-4 leads. 2. **AQL Acceptance Rate:** Target 70–85%. Below 60% = AE filter too aggressive, SDRs demotivated. 3. **AQL Bounce Rate:** Target 10–15%.
